Class TileSigner

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.jc2pa.TileSigner
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class TileSigner extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Signs IIIF tiles (or any image bytes) with C2PA manifests.

WASM instances are neither thread-safe nor allowed to hop host threads, so every lane of the internal pool pairs one interpreter instance with one dedicated worker thread that lazily creates it and never shares it. Separate instances are fully isolated (each owns its linear memory), which is what makes parallel signing sound. Tasks are routed round-robin across lanes; concurrent callers block for their own result.

Parallelism defaults to one lane per available processor capped at 4 (opt out with parallelism 1); a single lane behaves exactly like the previous dedicated signing thread. Request more or fewer lanes with TileSigner(String, int) (or --sink-opt threads=N on the c2pa sink); a shared C2paWasm instance always implies a single lane.

Two signing modes exist:

  • Ephemeral — signs with an ephemeral self-signed certificate chain. No key material required; intended for tests and demos. The produced manifests will not validate against any trust list.
  • Keys — signs with a PEM certificate chain and PEM private key supplied per call. This is the production path.

Each signing operation creates a fresh WASM-side builder, so the service can sign any number of tiles.

  • Constructor Details

    • TileSigner

      public TileSigner(String engineSelection) throws IOException
      Create a signer that owns its WASM instance(s), using the engine selected by engineSelection (see WasmEngine.create(String, byte[])). Uses a single lane; the sinks resolve the core-based default separately.
      Parameters:
      engineSelection - auto, chicory, graalvm, or null for the wasm.engine system property / auto.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the WASM module cannot be loaded.

    • TileSigner

      public TileSigner(String engineSelection, int parallelism) throws IOException
      Create a signer that owns its WASM instance(s), with the given lane parallelism. 1 selects the classic serial behaviour; larger values sign on that many lanes in parallel.
      Parameters:
      engineSelection - auto, chicory, graalvm, or null for the wasm.engine system property / auto.
      parallelism - Requested lane count; clamped to the available processors (and to 2 for GraalWasm).
      Throws:
      IOException - if the WASM module cannot be loaded.
      IllegalArgumentException - if parallelism < 1.

    • TileSigner

      public TileSigner(C2paWasm wasm)
      Create a signer sharing an existing WASM instance. The caller keeps ownership of the instance. A shared instance is always serial (parallelism 1).
      Parameters:
      wasm - Shared C2paWasm instance.

    • signEphemeral

      public byte[] signEphemeral(byte[] tileBytes, String format, String manifestJson, String certName) throws C2paException
      Sign a tile with an ephemeral self-signed certificate.
      Parameters:
      tileBytes - Raw tile bytes (e.g. JPEG or PNG).
      format - MIME type or file extension, e.g. "image/jpeg".
      manifestJson - C2PA manifest definition JSON.
      certName - Common name for the ephemeral certificate.
      Returns:
      Signed tile bytes.
      Throws:
      C2paException - on WASM error.
      IllegalStateException - if this signer has been closed.

    • sign

      public byte[] sign(byte[] tileBytes, String format, String manifestJson, byte[] certPem, byte[] keyPem, String alg, String tsaUrl) throws C2paException
      Sign a tile using a PEM certificate chain and PEM private key.
      Parameters:
      tileBytes - Raw tile bytes (e.g. JPEG or PNG).
      format - MIME type or file extension, e.g. "image/jpeg".
      manifestJson - C2PA manifest definition JSON.
      certPem - PEM-encoded certificate chain bytes.
      keyPem - PEM-encoded private key bytes.
      alg - Signing algorithm, e.g. "es256".
      tsaUrl - Optional timestamp authority URL (null = none).
      Returns:
      Signed tile bytes.
      Throws:
      C2paException - on WASM error.
      IllegalStateException - if this signer has been closed.

    • setTrustAnchors

      public void setTrustAnchors(String pem) throws C2paException
      Install a PEM trust anchor bundle for subsequently created readers (process-global in the WASM module, like all c2pa-rs settings). Readers then report "Trusted" instead of merely "Valid" when the signing chain anchors in the bundle.
      Parameters:
      pem - PEM bundle (one or more certificates), validated eagerly.
      Throws:
      C2paException - if the bundle is malformed.
      IllegalStateException - if this signer has been closed.
